figures.finding: Ukrainian is the state language by the constitution, which requires the state to ensure its functioning in all spheres of social life; no source on the film-language rule (Law on the state language, art. 23) was reached.

value.basis: constitution, not a statement on film

sources.said: The state language of Ukraine is the Ukrainian language. The State ensures the comprehensive development and functioning of the Ukrainian language in all spheres of social life throughout

figures.finding: A sectoral agreement between Ukraine's Ministry of Culture and Information Policy and the Trade Union of Culture Workers of Ukraine was registered by the Ministry of Economy in 2023 and runs to 2028; the report names no pay minimum for performers, and its text was not read.

value.name: Галузева угода між Міністерством культури та інформаційної політики України та профспілкою працівників культури України
signatories: Ministry of Culture and Information Policy of Ukraine
Trade Union of Culture Workers of Ukraine

figures.applies: Workers in Ukraine's culture sector under the ministry's sphere; whether it reaches film or television performers and what pay it sets was not established.
